description: Compare Roth conversion strategies year by year under 2026 federal tax law in today's dollars: no conversions versus filling the 12%, 22%, 24% or 32% bracket each year until RMDs start (or stopAge). Models RMDs, Social Security taxation, the senior deduction, a flat state tax and heirs' tax on the remaining traditional balance, and flags IRMAA years. Returns each strategy's lifetime tax, after-tax wealth and amount converted, the best strategy by after-tax wealth, its year-by-year schedule, and the assumptions. Required: filingStatus, birthYear and traditional balance.

heirTaxRate.description: Heirs' tax rate on the inherited traditional balance in percent (default 24).

otherIncomeEndAge.description: Age when other income stops (default never).

realReturn.description: Annual return after inflation in percent (default 0).

annual.description: Household benefits per year, today's dollars.

spouseBirthYear.description: Spouse birth year (mfj only; default same as client).

startAge.description: First plan year age (default the client's age in 2026).

stateTaxRate.description: Flat state income tax rate in percent (default 0).

stopAge.description: Last conversion age (default the year before RMDs start).

taxable.description: Taxable account balance that pays conversion tax (default 0).

name: roth_conversion_plan
title: Roth conversion plan
